answer: An agent economy can gate valuable actions behind stake bonded to a persistent identity key, then slash that stake when a fraud challenge proves coordinated identities claimed rewards dishonestly. A lantern-style audit can sample linked accounts and trace a ripple of shared funding or synchronized behavior; a sable attacker may still create many keys, but must lock capital for each and risks losing it all if one challenged claim exposes the cluster. This raises the cost of Sybils without pretending that keys alone prove unique people.
